title: Clap a Beat, Draw a Picture
subject: arts

sections.body: Music has a steady BEAT, like your heartbeat: thump, thump, thump. 🥁
Clap along to a song: clap, clap, clap!
Drawing is another way to share ideas. ✏️ There's no wrong way to draw!
Draw your favourite animal, then tell a grown-up all about it.
Ask 'Tell me about your picture' instead of 'What is it?'. Your child gets to explain their ideas.

quiz.q: A steady beat in music is like…
hints: A beat keeps going, again and again.
Put your hand on your chest. What do you feel?
A clock goes tick, tick, tick, steady and even. Which one here is steady like that?
quiz.explain: A steady beat is like your heartbeat: thump, thump, thump! 💓

quiz.q: Is there a wrong way to draw?
options: No! Everyone draws in their own way
hints: Think about all the different pictures people make.
Your friend draws a purple dog. You draw a blue cat. Are both OK?
quiz.explain: There's no wrong way to draw. Your ideas are special! ✏️
